description: Source code implementing common functionality for Buffer9 and Buffer11 classes in Direct3D rendering, including buffer management, static buffer caching, and usage updates.

classes.name: BufferD3D
classes.description: Implements common buffer functionality for Direct3D, managing static and dynamic buffers, buffer usage, and index range computation.

methods.name: updateSerial
methods.description: Updates the serial number for the buffer instance.

methods.name: updateD3DBufferUsage
methods.description: Sets buffer usage type based on OpenGL buffer usage and initializes static data if needed.

methods.name: initializeStaticData
methods.description: Creates static vertex and index buffers if they do not exist.

methods.name: getStaticVertexBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a static vertex buffer matching specific attributes and bindings.

methods.name: invalidateStaticData
methods.description: Clears static buffer caches and resets static buffers, reinitializing if static usage.

methods.name: promoteStaticUsage
methods.description: Promotes buffer usage to static if sufficient unmodified data has accumulated.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Computes the index range for a draw call based on buffer data.
